## File: facebookresearch_pytorch3d/pytorch3d/implicitron/third_party/hyperlayers.py

Prompts

```
['build a HyperFC hypernetwork that predicts a fully connected neural network from a hyper input', 'create a HyperLayer module that predicts a single dense layer with LayerNorm and ReLU', 'build a LookupFC network that uses object indices to look up per-object network weights', 'create a BatchLinear layer that applies batched weight matrices and biases to input tensors', 'review the HyperLinear module that predicts weights and biases for a single linear layer', 'build a multi-layer perceptron with FCBlock using Kaiming-normal initialized linear layers and LayerNorm', 'build a 2D U-Net segmentation model with configurable downsampling stages and upsampling mode', 'build a 3D U-Net segmentation model with configurable downsampling stages and max channels', 'create a downsampling network that builds a feature pyramid with strided convolutions and dropout', 'create a 2D upsampling block with transpose convolutions, batch norm, and optional pixel shuffle']
```

Usage

```
{'build_hyperfc_network': 'build a HyperFC hypernetwork that predicts a fully connected neural network from a hyper input', 'create_hyperlayer_module': 'create a HyperLayer module that predicts a single dense layer with LayerNorm and ReLU', 'build_lookupfc_network': 'build a LookupFC network that uses object indices to look up per-object network weights', 'create_batchlinear_layer': 'create a BatchLinear layer that applies batched weight matrices and biases to input tensors', 'review_hyperlinear_module': 'review the HyperLinear module that predicts weights and biases for a single linear layer'}
```
